Created in 1939 by French luxury house Van Cleef & Arpels, the Art Deco bib-style necklace features 673 brilliant-cut and baguette-cut diamonds set in pure platinum, totaling over 200 carats. _____ The theft follows a wave of aggressive high-profile cultural property crimes in Europe, including the major daylight jewel break-in at the Louvre in Paris and raids on ancient gold in Spain. candidateAudit.text: #art #photography #artphotography #wien #sandbichler . petersandbichler stadtwien vienna . Peter Sandbichler’s 12 Tones can be read as an investigation into how we construct space through perception. At first encounter, the work appears almost formally straightforward: repetition, colour, geometry and rhythm organised across a long architectural passage. The work gradually shifts our attention from the ceramic modules themselves to the unstable relationship between the body, the architecture and the act of seeing. . The twelve colours introduce a kind of visual syntax. Like notes within a musical scale, they are limited in number but capable of producing seemingly endless combinations. Repetition establishes order, while the subtle variations in surface and colour prevent that order from becoming static. The work therefore occupies an interesting space between system and experience: it is rigorously structured, but its meaning is never entirely fixed. . The concave and convex forms are particularly important. They create small perceptual ambiguities—surfaces appear to advance or recede, and the architecture seems to shift as the viewer moves. In this sense, Sandbichler is not simply decorating a tunnel; he is questioning the assumption that space is stable and objectively given. What we experience as architectural reality is, at least partly, produced by movement, perspective and attention. . There is also an intriguing contradiction at the centre of the work. candidateAudit.text: 🔥 Der Sommer‑Schnellzug nach „Animal“ rollt ins Stadtkino! Unter der glühenden Sonne und den stickigen Nächten eines endlosen Sommers bereiten Kalia und ihre kunterbunte Truppe von Hotelanimateur*innen den ultimativen Höhepunkt der Tourismussaison vor. Sichert euch jetzt eure Tickets über filmgarten.at/animal und erlebt, wie die Grenzen zwischen Realität und Filmwelt verschwimmen. candidateAudit.title: „Der Ausstellungsherbst beginnt" Am Freitag beginnt in Wien der Ausstellungsherbst, und zwar gleich zweifach. In der Albertina treffen Picasso und Bacon aufeinander. Bacon hat in P
candidateAudit.text: „Der Ausstellungsherbst beginnt" Am Freitag beginnt in Wien der Ausstellungsherbst, und zwar gleich zweifach. In der Albertina treffen Picasso und Bacon aufeinander. Bacon hat in Picasso zeitlebens eine Vaterfigur gesehen, und wer die Bilder nebeneinander sieht, versteht warum: derselbe Körper, einmal auseinandergenommen, einmal neu zusammengesetzt. Rund 70 Werke, bis 31. Jänner. Im Unteren Belvedere geht es leiser zu, aber nicht weniger interessant. Erika Giovanna Klien, Künstlerin des Wiener Kinetismus, bei der alles in Bewegung ist: Räder, Vögel, Maschinen. Lange kaum beachtet, jetzt in einer eigenen Schau. Zwei Häuser, ein Tag, zwei sehr verschiedene Arten, den Menschen anzuschauen. Wir zeigen dir gerne beide, mit genügend Zeit für das, was dazwischen liegt. ______ On Friday, Vienna's exhibition autumn begins. Twice over, as it happens. At the Albertina, Picasso meets Bacon. Bacon saw a father figure in Picasso all his life, and seeing the paintings side by side, you understand why: the same body, taken apart in one, reassembled in the other. Around 70 works, until 31 January. At the Lower Belvedere it is quieter, but no less interesting. Erika Giovanna Klien, an artist of Viennese Kineticism, in whose work everything is in motion: wheels, birds, machines. Long overlooked, now with a show of her own. Two museums, one day, two very different ways of looking at a human being. We would gladly take you to both, with enough time for what lies in between. #artemezzo #ArtemezzoMomente #Albertina #Belvedere #PicassoBacon #ErikaGiovannaKlien #KunstInWien #ArtemezzoMoments #Alber
